fields.inlineHelpText:
Tier 1 = $100,000 or more (10-12 visits per year)			
Tier 2 = $50,000 to $100,000 (6 visits per year)			
Tier 3 = $20,000 to $50,000 (4 visits per year)			
Tier 4 = Below $20,000 (1+ visits per year)
fields.label: Tier
fields.name: Tier__c

fields.calculatedFormula: IF( Data_Quality_Score__c =100,"All Account Details Captured", "Missing: "&IF( ISPICKVAL( Industry,""),"Industry, ","")&""&IF(ISPICKVAL(Rating,""), "Rating, ","")&""&IF( LEN(BillingCity) = 0, "Complete Address, ","")&""&IF( LEN(Phone) = 0, "Phone, ","")&""&IF( ISPICKVAL(Type,""), "Type",""))
fields.label: Data Quality Description
